profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Onboard RS
profile.summary:
Full-stack developer with over 25 years of experience, with a passion for front-end. I specialize in creating accessible, leading-edge web designs, but am just as comfortable working in any tier of software development from the front-end to the database.

Over the past few years, I have had the privilege of mentoring and guiding other developers in their career journeys. It has been a rewarding experience to take part in their growth and development.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.insights: Amazon Web Services (AWS), React.js and +3 skills

positions.title: Associate Director - IT Systems & Architecture
positions.description: Started out in charge of producing a react component library utilized by several teams in our division. Worked closely with UX team to make sure their vision was implemented successfully and efficiently. Assisted multiple teams and mentored developers as they got up to speed with react.js. Managed the "leveling" of an assigned team's developers to help them set goals and achieve success.
positions.insights: Azure Cosmos DB, React.js and +12 skills

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.insights: Web Accessibility, Code Review and +2 skills

positions.title: Senior UX Engineer
positions.description: Primarily responsible for selecting, developing, and maintaining the technologies used for UI: bootstrap and fontawesome type libraries, angular directives, LESS/CSS structure and utilization, and keeping a consistent overall look and feel. While my primary role is that of UX engineer, I still enjoy being able to jump into any project and working on any level of the stack.
positions.insights: Web Accessibility, Code Review and +1 skill

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
Designed and implemented several iterations of a robust CMS/E-commerce website for a local publishing company. 

My software has allowed their business to grow significantly and has earned them millions of dollars in contracts with partners to whom they supply their print materials.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed pharmaceutical and drug information applications which are used in hospitals and pharmacies throughout the country.  The primary product being a cross-platform API written in C++ that utilizes SOAP-based Web Services to deliver drug data.  We designed the engine for speed and efficiency, and it’s capable of processing hundreds of drugs and calculating their interactions in seconds.

Wrote and maintained several different editorial tools used by on-staff pharmacists to enter the drug information.  Systems were written with extensive auditing and workflow constraints to ensure correct data.  Written in a variety of languages, from Windows Forms with C#, to MVC3 web applications.

Served as Team Lead over a team of four other developers on these projects.  Responsible for designing the projects with the business stakeholders, as well as developing and assigning the work to the other team members.

projects.title: es-components
projects.description: Primary developer on a react component library built for use across our company's many development teams. Worked with the UX team to help define the look and feel and then implemented the components along with a demo site. Promoted team adoption and aided teams in setup and usage. It's since been taken over by a dedicated team but still remains one of my favorite achievements at WTW.

projects.title: react-datepicker
projects.description: One of the most downloaded datepicker components for react. A few years ago I contributed by converting the core of the component from using the moment.js library to date-fns, which had a much lighter footprint.
